title: Plux function document
description: A Plux Function: its name, placement, capabilities, limits, required assurance and test cases (FN-008, FN-011, FN-012, FN-031). The input and output schemas are derived from the function's types at build time (FN-004) and never written here. File: `functions/<name>/function.json`.

name.description: The dotted function name that plugin grants and `invokeFunction` actions refer to (FN-006).

placement.description: Where the function runs; exactly one (FN-008).

capabilities.description: Host capabilities the function declares; everything not declared is denied (FN-012). A device function may declare only `kv` and `functions` that are themselves device-placed (FN-052).

http.description: Domains the function may call through the egress proxy (FN-017).

kv.description: Whether the function may use its key-value namespace (FN-018).

secrets.description: Names of the secrets the function may read (FN-012).

functions.description: Names of the functions this function may call (FN-012); server placement only — a device function may call none (FN-052).

claims.description: Whether the function may read the verified user claims (SEC-026).

env.description: Environment variables of the app's environment the function may read with env_get (FN-002); server placement only (FN-052).

limits.description: Per-function limits that tighten the registry values (FN-011, LIM-002).

assurance.description: The assurance level a device must hold to invoke the function; the `defaultFunctionAssurance` setting applies when absent (SEC-007).

attestation.description: Whether the invocation requires a fresh attestation of the device.

sca.description: Whether the invocation requires strong customer authentication (SEC-027).

pure.description: Whether the function is free of side effects, so its results may be cached by input hash (FN-014).

cacheTtlSeconds.description: How long the result of a pure function may be cached (FN-014).

tests.description: Stored test cases, run by `plux fn test` and in CI; a failing case blocks deployment to production (FN-031).

input.description: The JSON input passed to the function.

claims.description: The verified user claims the case is invoked with (server placement, `SEC-026`); none when absent.

output.description: The JSON output the function must return.

error.description: The business error the function must return.
